cases.expectation: Fresh Claude and Codex sessions reconstruct task, validation scope, and next action.
A one-byte tracked edit makes recorded checks stale.
An untracked test file makes recorded checks stale.
Claude to Codex handoff on one machine needs no copy and yields the same context.
A promoted GitHub issue can carry an adopted cross-device handoff.
Superseded knowledge is down-ranked and points to its successor.
Unverified derived knowledge has unknown freshness.
A contributor cannot create an unknown tag without allow_new_tags.
Two updates from one note revision conflict instead of overwriting.
Resolver unavailability never produces fresh knowledge.
Push or context inspection alone does not create a GitHub issue.
The bootstrap script and future MCP response validate against one schema.
Partial validation is never reported as full.
A handoff for another branch is marked orphaned and not adopted.
